verdict.rationale: stagewise is an agentic IDE, and its AI works on the user's own data, mainly code and project context. On connecting a workspace it generates a WORKSPACE.md project summary (stagewise-docs-20), and the agent reads files and inspects screenshots and the browser console to debug (stagewise-docs-12, stagewise-docs-25, stagewise-gh-3). Its edits are proposed as reviewable diffs (stagewise-docs-6), and a Supabase plugin enables database queries (stagewise-docs-16). These are coding suggestions rather than a dedicated insights or analytics feature. missing for 10: explicit insight or analytics surfacing over user data, proactive suggestion features beyond code edits, independent hands-on corroboration of insight quality.
